track: A: Tabular FM context selection, optimization and scaling
language: English citation cards; Russian synthesis in track_a_notes.md
evidence_policy: Primary papers and official software only. Null code URLs and unknown licenses mean unverified in this search, not absence. Full_text means relevant full manuscript sections inspected, not independently reproduced. Reviewer inference is explicitly marked. No paper code was run.

sources.title: TabPFN: A Transformer That Solves Small Tabular Classification Problems in a Second
sources.authors: Noah Hollmann; Samuel Müller; Katharina Eggensperger; Frank Hutter
sources.code_license: Current inference code Apache-2.0; checkpoint terms are separate and version-specific, verified in official README.
sources.specific_claims: The pretrained transformer predicts new labels from set-valued training examples without downstream parameter updates. Authors evaluate small numerical classification tasks and compare prediction time with conventional fitting. This establishes the conditioning paradigm underlying later context-selection wrappers.
sources.context_mechanism: Synthetic-prior pretraining; labeled training rows form the inference context.
sources.label_compute_budgets: Original tests: up to 1,000 rows, 100 numeric features, 10 classes.
sources.limitations: Original small-data envelope; no treatment-effect objective.
sources.relevance_novelty: Reviewer inference: Frozen-backbone in-context adaptation is foundational prior art.
sources.scope: Tabular prediction; causal uplift not established by this source

sources.title: Accurate predictions on small data with a tabular foundation model

sources.code_license: Current inference code Apache-2.0; checkpoint terms are separate and version-specific, verified in official README.
sources.specific_claims: TabPFNv2 expands the model to classification and regression with heterogeneous inputs. A dataset conditions one-pass prediction; embeddings, fine-tuning and generative uses are also demonstrated. Row and feature attention costs motivate subsequent context compression and retrieval.
sources.context_mechanism: Alternating row/feature attention and synthetic-prior prediction.
sources.label_compute_budgets: Up to 10,000 samples and 500 features emphasized.
sources.limitations: A backbone release, not causal context selection.
sources.relevance_novelty: Reviewer inference: Use a version-specific model reference.

sources.title: Mixture of In-Context Prompters for Tabular PFNs
sources.authors: Derek Xu; Olcay Cirit; Reza Asadi; Yizhou Sun; Wei Wang
sources.specific_claims: MICP groups training data into support contexts and routes queries to a nearby prompter for batched inference. Complete MixturePFN additionally adapts PFNs to localized inference through bootstrapped context-aware fitting. It addresses both efficient routing and distribution mismatch introduced by locality.
sources.context_mechanism: MICP routes queries to bounded train-cluster contexts; CaPFN tunes adapters.
sources.label_compute_budgets: Prompters ceil(gamma N/B); validation selects routing/encoding choices.
sources.limitations: MICP-only and complete MixturePFN differ in parameter fitting.
